citations.title: In 2025, a record performance driving renewed ambition

sentences.text: Air Liquide completed its ADVANCE 2022-2025 plan, achieving compound comparable sales growth of 6.1% and return on capital employed of 11.2% at end-2025, above the 10% target.
Efficiency gains hit a record 631 million euros in 2025, well above the 400 million annual target, and operating margin excluding energy improved by 360 basis points cumulatively from 2022 to 2025.

sentences.quote: Our investments decisions during the period therefore totaled 1.5 billion euros, reaching new heights in industrial projects in particular. Our backlog, now at 5.5 billion euros, set a new record.
sentences.text: Investment decisions totaled 1.5 billion euros in the first quarter of 2026 and the backlog set a new record at 5.5 billion euros, supporting future growth.
At end-2025 the 12-month portfolio of investment opportunities stood at a record 4.6 billion euros, of which more than 40% in Electronics.
